features.name: lsat_z_clipped
features.description: Training-fold standardized LSAT score, clipped to reduce the influence of extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a centered continuous axis aligned with exam strength while limiting outlier leverage.

features.name: decile_mean_score
features.description: Average of first and third decile positions scaled from the observed 1-to-10 scale to 0-to-1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth academic standing measure that a linear margin can weight directly.

features.name: decile_change_score
features.description: Change from first to third decile scaled by the full decile span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds direction of longitudinal movement rather than only level.

features.name: decile_stability_score
features.description: One minus the absolute decile change scaled by the full decile span; higher values indicate steadier standing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures variability as a continuous severity measure for a linear margin.

features.name: lsat_decile_product_score
features.description: Product of clipped LSAT range score and clipped average decile score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple nonlinear alignment term that remains usable as a single linear input.

features.name: family_income_score
features.description: Family income bracket scaled from the observed 1-to-5 scale to 0-to-1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth socioeconomic context axis for margin shifts.

features.name: lsat_income_contrast_score
features.description: Clipped LSAT range score minus clipped family-income range score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the SVM represent performance relative to socioeconomic context with one signed input.

features.name: age_z_clipped
features.description: Training-fold standardized age value, clipped to reduce sensitivity to unusual records.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a centered demographic timing axis with bounded leverage.

features.name: fulltime_program_indicator
features.description: Indicator for the full-time program code.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets the linear margin capture systematic program-format shifts.

features.name: school_cluster_code_score
features.description: Maps the six reported school-cluster codes to a 0-to-1 scaled numeric projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate linear projection of school context without creating many sparse indicators.

features.name: academic_profile_coherence_judgment
features.description: A 0-to-1 assessor score of how coherent the academic profile appears when considering lsat, decile1, decile3, decile change, and decile stability; 0 means internally weak or inconsistent, 1 means jointly strong and consistent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth expert-style synthesis of academic signals that can align with a linear margin when simple arithmetic misses context.

features.name: contextual_support_stability_judgment
features.description: A 0-to-1 assessor score of likely logistical and financial support based on fam_inc, fulltime, age, and school cluster; 0 means more constrained context, 1 means more stable support context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes several contextual cues into a single smooth input, reducing burden on sparse or weakly ordered fields.
